topics.purpose: Define REST as named service instances whose routes bind external HTTP requests to explicit canonical operations without creating private backend semantics.

operations.name: Handle REST request
side_effects: only effects of invoked canonical operation

semantics.route_rule: Each REST route binds to an explicit canonical operation or read projection.
semantics.schema_rule: Request and response shapes are explicit.
semantics.authority_rule: REST exposure does not grant authority; applicable IAM/AC/runtime authorization remains separate.
semantics.backend_rule: REST is a transport/exposure binding, not a separate semantic backend.
semantics.instance_identity_rule: Logical REST instance identity is separate from its port.
semantics.error_rule: Errors are structured and transport-mapped without changing canonical semantics.

invariants.rule: Network/service identity, binding, lifecycle and authority remain explicit and separate.

hard_gates.condition: REST route implements private semantic mutation outside canonical operation
REST exposure grants authority by existence
route accepts unknown fields without owning schema rule
REST instance identity equals port number
transport error changes canonical semantic meaning
